shared_elements: schematic curvilinear carved motifs in low relief
profile creature/vessel forms with hooked or curled terminals
multiple separate motifs overlapping/abutting on one rock face
justification: Both surfaces carry several schematic, heavily outlined profile motifs with hooked or curling terminations crowded onto a single rock face, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows biomorphic subjects (a hand/limbed creature, a spiral, rounded animal-like bodies) while B shows unmistakable boats with upturned prows and rows of vertical crew strokes, a specific motif entirely absent in A.
